label: PDF
help: The PDF stays on this device.

label: Signature
help: Use a transparent PNG/JPEG, upload an image, or paste the output link from the Signature tool.

label: Drawn signature
help: Signature strokes drawn directly in this tool.

label: Position in PDF points
help: Drag the signature on the page preview or enter exact PDF-point coordinates.

label: Add a Content Credential
help: Records the signer from the profile when Use my details is on. This is optional provenance, not a regulated e-signature service.

label: Lock with an open password
help: The password is requested only when downloading and is never stored in tool state. Locking and Content Credentials cannot be combined because encryption would invalidate the credential.
